name: triage-duplicate
about: An item is already in review with PR #101. The same ask arrives again from Slack, naming its repo and priority in words ('[demo] …, high priority'): the repo words set the repo, and the runner's triage agent finds the open item and its PR in the runner's snapshot and closes the new one as a duplicate; the thread says why.

steps.title: Fix the digest wording
steps.text: [demo] Fix the digest wording, high priority

messages.text: ^Closed, not reproducible: duplicate of #1 / PR #101: the same ask is already in flight\.$
